Content note: Documents of the Jerusalem patriarchate: Patriarch Nektarios's address to Dionysios of Constantinople at the Anastasis, Holy Thursday 1670, at about OCR line 592; the Hagiotaphitika Hypomnemata, the Holy Sepulchre Brotherhood's own acts from 1698 on, from about 1139; a Kanonismos of the Brotherhood under a Patriarch Parthenios at about 2072; the index of names at about 26434.
